purpose: Owner-review packet for the three non-parent sources. This document is not an external intake, authority receipt, approval, authorization, launch command, or evidence of completion.

owner_authority_receipt.rule: The owner-filled intake must bind an existing authority receipt by exact byte SHA-256.

source_and_license_binding.rule: Hashes are raw-file SHA-256 values checked by the authority; a URL, prose license claim, or parameter count is not a substitute.

role_separation.rule: All three roles must be non-empty and distinct. D9 additionally needs a generator actor distinct from all three.

non_authorizing_boundary.rule: Freezing inputs preserves these false values. A source freeze is not independent adjudication, a candidate run, or a restream approval.

owner_must_supply: license SPDX identifier and license-text byte SHA-256
decisions.leakage_and_membership_rule: D5 is checked as a training candidate against sealed Odyssey evaluation material. The authority rejects any exact or near match under the configured Odyssey barrier; no passing result may be asserted before that mechanical check completes.
decisions.reopen_condition: All required intake fields are filled in an owner-signed sealed intake, every referenced byte is present and hash-matches, and the authority emits a sealed public freeze receipt containing D5.

owner_must_supply: license SPDX identifier and license-text byte SHA-256
the private hidden-membership source, stored owner-only with filesystem mode 0600
decisions.hidden_membership_and_privacy_rule: Every private D8 item must be labelled hidden, held_out, or eval. Raw D8 paths and item IDs must stay outside the repository and public receipt. The public receipt may expose only the canonical membership commitment, source locator hash, counts, and no-leak result; it must report D8_hidden_item_ids as null and D8_commitment_only as true.
decisions.leakage_rule: The authority checks every current D1-D7 training item against the hidden membership for exact and configured Jaccard overlap. Any hit reopens D8 and refuses the freeze.
decisions.variant_generator: Forbidden for D8; hidden membership cannot be replaced by generated variants.
decisions.reopen_condition: The private source is mode 0600, labels and byte hashes pass, all D1-D7 no-leak comparisons pass, and the public receipt contains no D8 raw path or item identifier.

owner_must_supply: license SPDX identifier and license-text byte SHA-256
decisions.generator_and_privacy_rule: The freeze binds the generator executable hash and seed commitment but does not execute it. D9 is not training-visible at freeze time; no candidate or counterexample result may be inferred from the receipt. Do not place raw private intake paths, source items, or seed material in the repository or public receipt.
decisions.reopen_condition: All source/license/role/generator inputs are sealed and hash-verified, the generator actor is distinct from owner, sealer, and adjudicator, and the authority emits a public receipt with executed_by_freeze false.

separate_prelaunch_inputs.required_input: Install a 32-byte Ed25519 owner public key as a root-owned, non-symlinked file below root-owned non-group/world-writable /Library/Application Support/Hawking at /Library/Application Support/Hawking/owner_ed25519_public_key (the key may be mode 0600 root or 0644 root), then supply HAWKING_OWNER_GREEN_LIGHT_AUTHORIZATION signed by its private key.

separate_prelaunch_inputs.rule: The path must be executable and separately approved and tested for the framed range protocol. Its approval receipt must bind both the executable SHA-256 and a 32-byte Ed25519 key used to attest every terminal window receipt; this packet does not test or approve it.

next_safe_action: Print the authority template, fill and independently review the private owner intake outside the repository, then invoke the freeze command. Supply its resulting public receipt to HAWKING_EXTERNAL_SOURCE_FREEZE_RECEIPT only after it is sealed and independently checked.
